property_summary: For any amount, c.withdraw(amount) must either revert or actually move exactly that amount out of address(c); the mutant silently 'succeeds' with a failed call-based transfer, returning ok=true while c's balance is unchanged (when the owner/receiver refuses ETH).
change_summary: Replace the msg.sender transfer with a call-based transfer that ignores success, changing revert/propagation behavior on failed transfers.
